purpose: Determine within the same frozen current sequential2B whether a trailing LF itself changes next-token EOS preference, after the existing32-unit observational diagnostic showed different TRAIN/DEV ending formats. Separate this narrowly testable boundary cue from unresolved semantic repetition and generalization.
selection: Exactly all32 already-bound actual-consumed Web TRAIN and separate DEV units in base_residual_train_dev_history_preparation.json; no additional draws, reselection or source edits. Diagnostic variants are not training data and never replace original DEV/test bytes.
variants: Original exact body IDs; original decoded text with only trailing LF characters removed; that same LF-stripped text plus exactly one LF. Preserve spaces, internal LF, punctuation and all other bytes. Retokenize counterfactual text with the existing pinned tokenizer, verify exact byte roundtrip and context<1024. Original body tokenization must retain its already-bound exact IDs. Never add, train on, or force a synthetic EOS.
inference: For each full original/counterfactual body, original BOS2 plus body only, same actual10M explicit residual factory, BF16/math. Measure the next-token unmasked EOS3 probability/rank, next-token LF preference if its tokenizer encoding is a single token, top8 IDs/probabilities and decoded raw bytes. No free generation or optimizer update. EOS is a queried next-token event, not an observed gold boundary claim on altered text.
screen: For all32 paired stripped-LF versus one-LF variants, report per-unit EOS probability difference. Supports a strong LF cue within these fixed weights only if median P(EOS|oneLF)-P(EOS|noTrailingLF)>0.25 and at least24/32 differences are positive. Report both populations and all variants regardless of screen outcome. Do not modify this rule after reading GPU outputs.
completion: Implement missing typed command and durable launcher first; protocol fixtures for LF-only edits/context/original bytes. Actual exited<=30seconds job, all96 next-token records, unchanged weights/RNG/eval-mode, closed PID/boot/start GPU ledger, original idle10B UI restored, CPU paired summary and local commit. Preserve any failure and do not sweep markers or normalize DEV to pass a gate.
interpretation: A positive result establishes a local ending-marker sensitivity of the frozen model, not that stripping/appending LF improves general free generation, causes the full TRAIN/DEV gap, resolves repetition, or qualifies Base. A negative result leaves source/topic/completion differences unresolved. Any later learning comparison needs its own source/quantity/budget/quality protocol.
